messages:
Avery: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on strategy/positioning. Drop short Qs.

Dante: For one-pagers, should we lead with 'developer-first' or 'inference economics'? Need a single hero line.

Riya: Use developer-first for engineer-facing assets. For buyer-facing one-pagers, lead with 'predictable inference economics' then call out controls (KMS, SLAs).

Marta: Competitor quick: cloud vendors lowering GPU price  what is our 2-sentence rebuttal?

Sam: Rebuttal: "Lower instance price doesn't equal predictable cost or latency. We offer SLO-backed behavior, per-route cost visibility, and private deployments to avoid hidden infra risk."

Dante: Console roadmap: when do we get per-route token/cost views?

Riya: Targeting Q3 for public beta. Internal demos available sooner; ping me.

Marta: Any change to Dedicated packaging? Heard about burst credits.

Avery: Adding burst-credit option and clearer committed tiers; no pricing overhaul. Finance will publish details next week.

Sam: For demos before tracing beta, show per-request logs + replay fallback using this sample config: {"route":"demo","fallback":["rwd-small"],"latency_slo_ms":150}.

Avery: Thanks all  if you need collateral, DM Sam/Riya. Leaving thread open 24h. :sparkles:
